edge_semantics: A derivation-record node declares the raw/key parent hashes literally recorded in its DERIVATION.json. Parent nodes are terminal only within this intentionally partial graph; no complete station or model ancestry is asserted.
limitations: All edges are caller declarations; results apply only to this supplied graph.
Omitted edges or nodes can change common ancestors; empty output does not establish independence.
Byte hashes bind local files, not authenticity, source truth, causal independence or confidence.
Flat registry shared hashes do not establish a complete actual derivation graph.
